features: Expansive Artist Hero & Balanced Layout: Restored full-height portrait photography (480px) with ~250px of breathing room so portraits are never obstructed
Scroll-Linked Dynamic Island: Header capsule stays collapsed at rest and only springs open to reveal the title when scrolling past the hero
Edge-to-Edge Fullview Player: Expanded bounds eliminate right-side subpixel gaps across all display sizes
Strict Multi-Field Lyric Matching: Zero mismatched lyrics with multi-word overlap validation and YouTube official lyrics fallback
Pristine Audience Formatting: Monthly listeners formatted cleanly without duplicate phrases (e.g. 40.8 crore monthly listeners)
fixes: Fixed Dynamic Island showing title before scrolling past artist and album headers
Fixed display gap on right side of full-view player screen
Fixed duplicate 'monthly audience monthly listeners' metric text on artist profiles
Fixed inaccurate lyric match across multi-language releases
improvements: Freshly built v1.0.12 (Build 16) release APK with optimized asset footprint
Silky-smooth spring physics on Dynamic Island transitions
Enhanced stream proxying and zero preview audio limits
